description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla and four variations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and utilizes a non-linear scale with specific tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, and then in regular increments of 1e8 from 1e8 up to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and employs a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 94 to 100 at intervals of 1 unit, though the data extends slightly above the 100 mark. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, showing a steady, gradual increase from approximately 100.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs to roughly 101.5 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with cross markers, starting at roughly 98.4 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rising to a local peak of approximately 101.2 at 2e8 TFLOPs, dipping slightly to 100.9 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and ending near 101.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration is depicted by a solid blue line with 'x' markers, beginning at 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs and rising steadily to end at approximately 101.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is a solid green line with diamond markers, starting at 97.6 at 1e7 TFLOPs and following a steady upward trend to also end near 101.8 at 9e8 TFLOPs. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is represented by a solid red line with circle markers; it starts at the lowest value of approximately 94.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises sharply to 100.4 at 2e8 TFLOPs, experiences a slight decline to 99.9 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then continues to rise, ending at roughly 101.0 at 9e8 TFLOPs.
